body:
Three things cost a fresh machine an investigation today, each surfacing as a cryptic error minutes in:
a JRE with no javac (Gradle: "toolchain does not provide JAVA_COMPILER"); a JVM whose sun.jnu.encoding
is not UTF-8 (Kotlin internal compiler error writing a class file for a test name containing an em
dash); and the Android stage's --offline, which fails on any clone whose Gradle cache is cold. Add a
preflight to verify-all.sh's Android stage that checks javac, the JVM's file.encoding/sun.jnu.encoding,
and sdk.dir, and fails with one sentence each; and make --offline a fallback for a warm cache rather
than an unconditional flag.
title: verify-all.sh preflight: name a missing javac, a non-UTF-8 JVM, a cold Gradle cache — before Gradle does, cryptically
